gap.comment: Label-to-control and control-to-caption gap, and the label-to-asterisk gap within the label row — Figma uses the same 4px value for all three

labelFontSize.comment: Figma Fields node 4011-4962. TextArea's own wrapper (node 4011-5267) shows a bolder body-md/medium label and a body-sm/14px caption instead of caption/12px — treated as a one-off inconsistency in that node and normalized to Fields' spec here, so a Field looks the same regardless of what control it wraps.

errorColor.comment: Mandatory asterisk and caption text color while error
